These unmodified `Processing.NDI.*.h` headers were extracted from the official
NDI 6 SDK downloaded at https://downloads.ndi.tv/SDK/NDI_SDK_Linux/Install_NDI_SDK_v6_Linux.tar.gz
on 2026-09-30. Each header contains its MIT license and copyright notice.
The header license is distinct from the NDI SDK/runtime license.

No NDI binary or import library is included in the source tree. Both programs
load the official Windows x64 runtime from their executable directory or from
`NDI_RUNTIME_DIR_V6` / `NDI_RUNTIME_DIR_V5`. Install the runtime from
https://ndi.link/NDIRedistV6.

SDK documentation: https://docs.ndi.video/all/developing-with-ndi/sdk
